name: – Tomáš Zdechovský – After § 96 – Am 5
title: REPORT on discharge in respect of the implementation of the budget of the European Public Prosecutor’s Office for the financial year 2023
part_text: 96a. Strongly condemns the unacceptable inaction of the EPPO, which, despite having announced the opening of investigations into the purchase of COVID-19 vaccines on 14 October 2022, has to this date failed to deliver any tangible results; stresses that such prolonged silence and lack of transparency regarding matters involving billions of euro of taxpayers’ money are utterly intolerable; demands that the EPPO conclude these investigations without any further delay and publish all findings in full, ensuring complete transparency and accountability towards European citizens;
